stem.text: Some agar was coloured pink using a pH indicator. The pink agar was then used to make three agar cubes with different dimensions.

stem.alt: Cube with printed dimensions 2 cm × 2 cm × 2 cm.
Cube with printed dimensions 4 cm × 4 cm × 4 cm.
Cube with printed dimensions 5 cm × 5 cm × 5 cm.

stem.text: The cubes were placed in a beaker and covered with $0.1\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid. The temperature of the experiment was standardised at $20\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
Hydrochloric acid diffused into the agar cubes causing the cubes to become colourless.
What is the surface area to volume ratio of the agar cube that became colourless in the **least** amount of time?
